This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 160/2022, registered at Police Station Baihar,
District Balaghat (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376 and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Section 5, 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is minor and rape has been committed on her by applicant.
In these circumstance, bail application may be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is aged 16 years and 11 months.
6. Considering 164 statement of prosecutrix recorded in Court, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr. P. C.
8. C.C. as per rules.
